title: Gap phenomenon of holomorphic maps between Shilov boundaries of type-I bounded symmetric domains
summary: Motivated by the gap phenomenon for proper holomorphic maps between complex unit balls, this paper investigates smooth CR maps $f$ from an open piece $M$ of the Shilov boundary of the unit ball $B^s$ into the Shilov boundary $S_{r',s'}$ of a higher-rank Type I bounded symmetric domain $Ω_{r',s'}$. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to systematically establish a general gap phenomenon in the higher-rank setting.
